row.notes: Resolves a 4-byte entity handle: rcx ctx, rdx -> handle {u8 kind at +0, u16 index at +2}. 0x14243fd10 is a jmp thunk to the body at .data1 0x14ca67b00. kind must be <= 2 (ePreLoaded, eUserDefined, eNetworkReplicated, names at 0x145612e60). [ctx+0x328+kind*0x10] points to a vector header whose 16-byte entries run [hdr+8]..[hdr+0x10]; the result is the qword at entry+8 (0x14ca67b42). A null header or kind > 2 returns 0 and logs "Vehicle with stat id %s not found" on ENTRANTS_SYSTEM (id formatted "%s %u" from kind name and index) only when the byte at 0x14604bac4 is 1 and that channel is enabled; with kind > 2 that log reads the name past the 3-entry table. An index at or past the entry count returns 0 with no log (0x14ca67b38). About half the call sites pass e+0x5c and many others a stack copy of the handle; 0x14379dd00 passes rsi+0x58 (0x14379ddad). Callers: census steam 0x243fd10.
